shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright pillar/slab
animal figures in profile rendered in relief
raised framing band/register border enclosing motifs
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief figures on the face of an upright slab, with animal-like forms set inside a raised rectangular frame or register, and both share a schematic, outline-and-flat-plane relief convention. However, A presents a dense multi-register composition (a row of arched creatures over a fringed band, then predators, a small human-like figure, a plant/branch motif and a large long-necked bird), while B shows only a single sparse framed panel with one or two indistinct figures, so the specific content and arrangement barely correspond.
